hero.title: Your AI-Powered Public Speaking Coach
hero.subtitle: The Smart Mirror for Public Speaking.

eyeContact.title: Eye Contact Tracker
eyeContact.description: Real-time detection of your gaze direction. Get instant feedback when you look away from the camera too long.

posture.title: Posture Guard
posture.description: AI monitors your body language — slouching, fidgeting, and passive hands. Get gentle reminders to stand confident.

filler.title: Filler Word Counter
filler.description: Catches every "um", "uh", and "you know" in real-time. Track your progress as filler words decrease over time.

wpm.title: Voice Speedometer
wpm.description: Monitors your words per minute with a rolling average. Stay in the ideal 100-160 WPM range for clear delivery.

scriptTemplate.title: AI Script Builder
scriptTemplate.description: Brainstorm, create, and refine your speech scripts interactively with our AI consultant. Ready-to-use templates can be easily tailored to your needs.
